name: Luminous Pearl Library
description: A hidden underwater cavern filled with towering bookshelves of glowing pearl‑covered volumes, their light casting gentle reflections on the surrounding coral and schools of bioluminescent fish.
prompt: A secret underwater grotto, walls lined with enormous pearl‑encrusted books floating in mid‑air, soft turquoise water, shafts of sunlight filtering through the surface, shimmering crystals and glowing coral, hyperrealistic lighting, photorealistic underwater scene, no text on books, serene and mysterious atmosphere.
caption: Dive into the depths where knowledge glows like pearls—discover the underwater library that whispers stories to the sea.
